mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 5.0% consistently indicates a tight monetary policy environment that increases discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of broader economic conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window in the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 4.0% signals robust labor market conditions that accelerate consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate accelerating aggregate demand that drives corporate revenue growth and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive returns when SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-supply-shock recovery regimes, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing output acceleration that supports corporate profit growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO rises during post-supply-shock recovery periods over the last 10 years.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL above 205.0 indicates elevated inflation that triggers central bank rate hike expectations, compressing equity multiples and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts (HOUST) increase exceeding 0.5% signals strong residential construction activity that boosts related sector growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST rises > 0.5% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent payroll growth (PAYEMS) and unemployment rate decline (UNRATE) indicate labor market tightening that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails when SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of such instances over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%), high interest rates suppress corporate borrowing and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% during monetary tightening cycles over the last 10 years.
